title: Zesty Chinese Peanuts Kung Pao
description: A sweet and juicy Chinese dish featuring peanuts and gluten-free friendly ingredients, perfect for a sick day pick-me-up.
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
Add the peanuts to the skillet and deep-fry until golden brown, about 5 minutes.
Remove the peanuts from the oil with a slotted spoon and set aside on a paper towel-lined plate.
In the same skillet, add the minced ginger and garlic and stir-fry until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add the chopped scallions to the skillet and stir-fry for an additional 30 seconds.
In a small bowl, whisk together the gluten-free soy sauce, hoisin sauce, sugar, salt, and red pepper flakes.
Pour the sauce mixture into the skillet and stir to combine with the ginger, garlic, and scallions.
Add the deep-fried peanuts back into the skillet and stir to coat with the sauce.
Transfer the skillet to a binchotan grill and cook for an additional 2 minutes, stirring frequently.
Remove the skillet from the grill and serve the Zesty Chinese Peanuts Kung Pao hot.
